newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in active trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended unchanged against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday despite the U.S. unit's persistent rise in Tokyo and other Asian markets.
The local unit finished at T$27.450, the same as Tuesday's close, after a day of relatively heavy turnover of US$331.5 million through dealers.

Sharp fluctuations were unlikely in the near term despite the big U.S. dollar push, they said, because strong demand for the local currency ahead of the Chinese lunar new year on February 7 had offset the Taiwan dollar's depreciation.
